snippet.title: Eye to Eye Gameplay
snippet.description:
Eye to Eye is an action platformer for the Playdate that is currently in development. The goal has been to create an exciting, moody, Greek mythology-themed take on the single-screen platformer with satisfying game feel all done in the limited web browser-based tool Pulp.

Trailer coming soon and full game to release in the coming months!
